meta.scope: The graph records the 222 computational machines in the transition-table compendium; the 18 discursive machines are outside it.
meta.level_note: The level ladder is an authored pedagogical ordering, not a relation derived from the transition tables.

layout.description: Each level uses family angular sectors; machines occupy radial bands inside a sector; each machine's states form a local ring.
layout.z_coordinate: The position z value is the authored level number.
